correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts all even-palindromic factorizations with four ones: either a single four-one block or two two-one blocks. It derives two necessary-and-sufficient parity/gap conditions, independently parametrizes each family and their intersection, then obtains \(\frac{1+5x+x^2+x^3}{(1-x)^5(1+x)}\), a valid exact quasipolynomial and the conditional limiting density \(1/4\). Direct DP rechecked all 18,832 eligible words through length 22; coefficient identities were checked to \(m=39\). Finite checks are supplementary, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial positive-weight palstar layer with competing positive-block patterns is four ones: one four-one palindrome or two two-one palindromes. Their exact overlap produces a complete membership criterion, all-length quasipolynomial and limiting conditional density \(1/4\). This is a natural content-refined enumeration useful as a boundary case for palindrome-product language counting, not an arbitrary finite table or a reformulation of the total word-length counts.
